fragments.text: In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a sacred assembly; you may not do any form of work, a day of Teruah shall it be for you.
You shall prepare a whole-offering of sweet savour to the Lord, one young bullock, one ram, seven flawless lambs in their first year.
Their meal-offering shall be of flour mixed with oil, three tenths for the bullock, two tenths for the ram
for each of the seven lambs.
And also one he-goat as a sin-offering to atone for you.

Apart from the whole-offering of the new moon and its meal-offering and the regular whole-offering with its meal-offering and their drink-offerings according to their rule for a sweet savour, a fire offering to the Lord.
